decision_scope: strict same-word analysis of the Bhāṣya joined to Kāśikā 7.2.60 for kṛp
policy: Evaluate the 7.2.59/60 condition on an actual taṅ or āna of the same primary word. An entitlement used to select an auxiliary is stored on its own edge.

primary_construction.as_or_bhū: their P in this kartari construction

carrier.inputs: root and desire, middle base entitlement, ām policy, person/number, auxiliary, and outer sandhi convention
carrier.arrows: The strict relation fixes the primary and passes the entitlement only along the 1.3.63 edge. The alternative permits it to control an earlier inner iṭ. These are separate models.
carrier.projection: On each strict branch erasing the two-word history after external sandhi recovers the corresponding PG121 word. Changing the auxiliary or sandhi edge cannot change the primary. Keeping the policy tag prevents the union of the two repositories from being read as optional traditional variation.
